ACME Technologies Limited
Q1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call
MANAGEMENT: MR. RAVI KUMAR – CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
MS. ANITA DESAI – CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER

Moderator: Ladies and gentlemen, good day and welcome to the ACME Q1 FY27 earnings call. I now hand over to Mr. Ravi Kumar.
Ravi Kumar: Thank you. This quarter we grew revenue by 9% year on year. For FY27 we expect revenue growth of 18% to 20% in rupee terms. We will continue to invest in our people.
Anita Desai: On margins, we expect EBITDA margin to be in the range of 20% to 21% for the full year. Our capex for the year will be around Rs 400 crore. Headcount will grow to about 15,000 people by the end of the year.
Moderator: The first question is from the line of Rahul Shah from XYZ Securities.
Rahul Shah: Thanks. Do you expect 20% growth next year as well? What is the margin outlook?
Ravi Kumar: We are confident of double-digit growth next year. In constant currency terms we should grow 15% to 17% for FY27.
Moderator: Thank you. That was the last question.
